description: OBJ-BACKFILL-1: P1 (Custodes) Movement, only the Custodian Guard and a Witchseekers squad free to move. The Custodian Guard is planned onto obj_nml_1 then converts to attacking the Kommandos, re-opening obj_nml_1. The Witchseekers had been redirected to obj_center because obj_nml_1 looked covered; they must now switch back to obj_nml_1 (their top score) instead of leaving it empty. The Suggest card shows the switch.

steps.comment: the suggested unit is the forward-placed Witchseekers squad

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("switched from obj_center to backfill") or main._ai_suggestion_panel.breakdown_text.contains("backfilling for a unit that went hunting")
steps.comment: MERGE (lab AI + main's terrain-aware range): the card says the Witchseekers backfill obj_nml_1 for the Guard that went hunting. With the lab's FIX-HELD-DUP need ledger and main's per-model range, obj_center (OC 8 vs 2) needs no OC, so the Witchseekers are not first redirected there and the backfill is a fresh capture ('backfilling ...') rather than a switch ('switched from obj_center ...'); either wording is the OBJ-BACKFILL-1 outcome
